999008199.text: 面白い本はありましたか？

localizations.en: Did you find any interesting books?

999008199.text: トトリちゃん！　調べものは一段落ついたの？

localizations.en: Totori! Are you done with your research?

999008199.text:
ロロナ先生は、とっても真剣に読んでましたけど
いい本が見つかったみたいですね

localizations.en: You were reading so intently, Miss Rorona. Looks like you found a good book.

999008199.text:
えへへ。すっかり夢中になっちゃった。ここには
本当に色んな本がたくさんあるよね

localizations.en: Ehehe. I got completely absorbed in it. There really are so many different kinds of books here!

999008199.text:
この中から目的の本を見つけるのは
ちょっと大変そうよねぇ……

localizations.en: Finding the book you're looking for among all these would be quite a challenge...

999008199.text:
そうなんだ！　でも、すっごくいい本を見つけてね。
じゃーん！

localizations.en: That's true! But I found this really great book. Ta-da!

999008199.text:
囚われたお姫様が騎士に助けられてね、
二人で幸せになる話なんだ～！

localizations.en: It's about a captive princess who gets rescued by a knight, and they live happily ever after!

999008199.text: へぇ……ロマンティックな本があるんですね

localizations.en: Oh... That sounds like a romantic story.

999008199.text:
もっとお堅い本ばかりあると思ってたから、
意外よね

localizations.en: I thought there would only be non-fiction books here. That's surprising.

999008199.text:
わたしもね、初めはそう思ってたんだ！
なのにこーんな素敵な本があったんだよ

localizations.en: I thought so too at first! But then I stumbled upon this wonderful book.

999008199.text:
やっぱりお話はハッピーエンドが一番だよねぇ。
お話の結末は、幸せでなくちゃ！

localizations.en: Stories really are best when they have happy endings. A story's ending has to be happy!

999008199.text:
ふふ。ロロナ先生らしいな。特にどんなところが
面白かったんですか？

localizations.en: Hehe. That's so like you, Miss Rorona. What part did you find most interesting?

999008199.text:
やっぱりお姫様を助けてくれる騎士かな。
すっごくかっこよくてねぇ……

localizations.en: Definitely where the knight rescues the princess. He was so cool...

999008199.text: 騎士が姫を助けるのは当然のことだが

localizations.en: It is only natural for a knight to rescue a princess.

999008199.text:
ステルクさんはそう言いますけど、
本当にかっこいいんですよー？

localizations.en: You say that, Sterk, but he really was amazing!

999008199.text: しかし特別なことでもないだろう？

localizations.en: But surely it is nothing particularly special?

999008199.text: この世界でも変わらないよねぇ

localizations.en: They never change, no matter what world we're in.
